//: Per-wave persona sets (scripts/lib/persona-sets.mjs, release-folder.md §7.1). `accounts`: the shared accounts each set clones — store names (USER, ORG_USER: their *_EMAIL variables) and test-data aliases (USER_DEFAULT…: their login fields). A clone's login derives from the original's (agent-test-wave-<set>-<local part>@test-agent.com), so nothing per clone is written here. Create them on a stand with `npm run seed:wave-personas`; bind a session with `npm run persona:use -- <set>`. An account with set-specific fixtures (orders, memberships) is listed only once its seeder can run for a clone.
